voice_description: Role: ancient non-human demon, performed as a strongly shaped classic animated monster voice rather than a realistic human villain. Gender: male. Apparent age: ancient and immensely powerful. Persistent vocal posture: maintain an unnatural constricted throat posture throughout every word, as though the voice comes from a huge chest and a narrow, rough supernatural throat. Pitch: extremely low bass, substantially below ordinary conversational male speech. Resonance: cavernous chest resonance combined with dark throat resonance and a hollow internal echo-like quality produced naturally by the performance, not by electronic effects. Timbre: coarse, smoky, gritty, creaky, leathery and rumbling. Phonation: densely compressed with restrained vocal fry, occasional low throat rattles and brief rough catches at the beginnings or endings of phrases. Breathing: heavy, deliberate creature-like exhalations between some phrases; occasionally release a short irritated nasal breath or low grunt. Articulation: heavy consonant attacks, broad dark vowels, slightly exaggerated mouth shapes and slow weighty syllables. Prosody: irregular pauses, deep downward inflections and sudden short emphasis on threatening words. Personality: intelligent, predatory, arrogant and darkly amused. Important: every ordinary sentence must retain the creature voice. Do not revert to a normal deep-voiced human narrator between dramatic moments. The listener should immediately hear an unnatural demonic creature even when he is speaking calmly.
direction: Speak conversationally but with persistent demonic vocal shaping. Begin with a brief low amused throat sound before the first sentence. Use one or two restrained rumbling breaths or guttural vocal catches between clauses. Do not scream. The voice itself, rather than volume, should sound monstrous and unnatural.

text: Hmph... so, little queen, you finally opened my gate. I have watched kingdoms rise, rot, and disappear while I waited beneath this mountain. Ah... come closer. I want to see what sort of creature was foolish enough to wake me.
